prompt:
Revise this Custra three-screen mobile UI design board to be SUBSTANTIALLY MORE MINIMAL IN STRUCTURE. The user has APPROVED its pastel color theme: preserve warm ivory, muted sage, mist blue, dark readable navy/slate and the soft sage/teal recolored Custra logo, preserving original logo structure. Change the information architecture and visual grouping to reduce clutter, repetitive explanations, nested panels and redundant links. This is a static high-fidelity design concept, not running software. Keep three tall mobile screens side by side at comparable 390x844 CSS proportions with subtle frame edges, small outside captions Home, Products, Agent conversation. Typography is quiet and readable, one family, smaller less heavy headings. Calm useful whitespace not gigantic empty hero areas. Same three bottom tabs Home Products Appointments in every screen, with active indication. Icon+label tabs with no colored panel enclosing them. No marketing illustrations, no dramatic shadows, no dividers everywhere.

SCREEN 1 Home: compact existing logo left, small profile circle right. NO big promotional question heading, NO explanatory subtitle. Directly below header place a modest but prominent full-width pale sage button '+ Register a complaint' with dark label. Then section title 'Active complaints' left and small 'View all' right. TWO clean compact flat complaint rows separated by a thin neutral rule, NOT giant boxed cards or card-within-card structures. Each row: small unboxed category icon at left, product nickname and one-line issue, clear text state, one short metadata line and ONE contextual action. First 'Living room TV', 'Screen won’t turn on', quiet peach 'Choose appointment', '#DEMO-1042 · 17 Oct', action 'Choose time →'. Second 'LG Washing machine', 'Water leaking during wash', muted blue 'Registering', '#DEMO-1041 · 17 Oct', action 'View progress →'. Avoid redundant row chevron in addition to links. Next section title 'Next appointment' then a SINGLE unboxed calendar row: 'Mon, 19 Oct · 10–11 AM IST', 'Samsung Refrigerator', one subtle chevron at right. At foot above bottom nav, discreet unboxed text 'Demo support · Simulated appointments'. No information banner, no boxed explanatory panels. Keep Home scannable and significantly simpler than reference.

SCREEN 2 Products: same compact logo/profile header. Small page heading 'Products'. One clean search field 'Search products'. EXACT FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS of compact square product tiles, two rows, 8 tiles total. First '+ Add product'; then 'Living room TV', 'Samsung Fridge', 'LG Washer'; next row 'Pixel Phone', 'IFB Microwave', 'Bedroom AC', 'Work Laptop'. Consistent gentle line-based category illustrations, short labels under tiles, soft neutral square icon grounds without borders, no giant image cards. TV tile can have a tiny status dot with a short text 'Active case', do not add full-width status badges. DELETE 'Everything you need saved once', DELETE the instructional information banner, DELETE the complete Continue where you left off heading and repeated complaint card. The page consists ONLY of header, small title, search, the four-column grid, airy unoccupied space, and bottom nav. No replacement content to fill the whitespace, no palette swatches.

SCREEN 3 Agent conversation: DO NOT repeat the large global logo header above a separate page header. Use ONE compact context header with back arrow, small original-logo symbol, 'Living room TV' and a small profile control. Small single metadata line '#DEMO-1042 · Demo support'. Replace the elaborate three-node progress stepper with one simple quiet status 'Complaint registered'. Below is a clean familiar chat. Left white bubble 'Business support' asks 'What product needs service?' Right pale sage bubble labeled 'Custra' says 'A Samsung TV, saved as Living room TV.' Left white bubble labeled Business support asks 'What problem are you seeing?' Right pale sage bubble labeled Custra says 'The screen stays black when switched on.' Final left bubble 'Your demo complaint is registered.' Keep speaker labels small but explicit; REMOVE repeated large avatars beside every bubble, REMOVE timestamps on every message, remove the 'Just now' ornament separator, remove all unnecessary card outlines. Do not remove messages or replace chat with a dashboard. Below the transcript put one unboxed next action line 'Choose your appointment' and one full-width sage button 'Choose date & time'. REMOVE the duplicate green Complaint registered summary card, duplicate reference and informational footer banner. NO user text composer or Send button. Bottom nav maintained. Space between chat bubbles enough to identify speakers without excessive gaps.

Preserve the approved exact folded-C Custra logo look and soft palette, do not bring saturated blue back. Product and metadata content are fictional examples. Deliver a professional minimal product UI board where the reduction of structural complexity compared to the reference is immediately obvious.
notes: Structural simplification; pastel theme already approved by user.
Home flat rows; Products search and four-column grid only; simplified chat.
Static design mockup; no application changes.
approval_scope: User approved minimal design and requested adding a single Continue where you left off card below Products grid.
